437:t_3:51.en:
$n
「For now, we can just let $$ＡＧ$$ run loose. After all, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ is apparently beyond even what this guy expected.」

437:t_3:52.en:
$n
「In other words, not everything is going to go the way this guy wants.」

437:t_3:54.en:
$n
「Just getting to see you all flustered made it worth it for $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ to be born.」

437:t_3:57.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「N-no way... Everyone... You really don't trust me after all, do you.」

437:t_3:58.en:
$$キラ$$
「You know the phrase 'you reap what you sow'...?」

437:t_3:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right. If you want people's trust, you should make sincerity and honesty your selling points every single day.」

437:t_3:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I do apologize. Our $$Ｄトレーダー$$ doesn't carry such items.」

437:t_3:62.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At any rate, I now understand that $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ is a mode that is unlocked as your awareness rises, $n.」

437:t_3:63.en:
$n
「So it's the same as with $$ジェニオン$$ and $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$?」

437:t_3:64.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You sortie in $$ジェニオン$$... after that comes $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, and the finish is $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$. In other words, it's a two-step form change.」

437:t_3:65.en:
$n
「Understood. I'll make sure I master it.」

437:t_3:66.en:
$n
「(Also for the sake of saving Miss $$スズネ$$...)」

437:t_3:67.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough chatter. Everyone, to your posts.」

437:t_3:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$c will change course and head for the Moon of $$翠の地球$$.」

437:t_3:70.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... does that mean...」

437:t_3:71.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes. Queen $$ディアナ$$ of the Moon has sent us a request for rescue.」

437:t_3:73.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The $$ムーンレィス$$ are fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ too, aren't they?」

437:t_3:74.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yeah... But the enemy isn't specifically targeting the Moon itself, so I don't think the fighting there has gotten all that big, but...」

437:t_3:75.en:
$$ロラン$$
「($$ディアナ$$... What on earth has happened on the Moon...)」

437:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was actually supposed to mean that a 'body' - MI - enters the husk of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$. Ge-MI-nion, you see.」

437:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's fine... It was unforeseen, but if it makes for a more powerful unit, I have nothing to complain about.」

437:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Besides, through the battles with that $$アムブリエル$$ to come, $n will only grow stronger and stronger.」

437:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today again, the two battles with $$アムブリエル$$ produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

437:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$... How far will it grow from here, I wonder...」

437:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What is it, $n...? Haven't you finished complaining yet?」

437:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's always 'you can't be trusted,' 'you're a Chip-miser,' 'you're a sexual harassment robot,' 'your Dimension Jokes are lame,' 'the $$Ｄトレーダー$$'s goods are too expensive'...」

437:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'Your legs are too short,' 'you talk vulgarly,' 'you hide too much,' 'your advice is careless,' 'you're so wide you get in the way'...」

437:t_10:18.en:
$n
「I wasn't going to say anything like that...」

437:t_10:20.en:
$n
「Well, since you brought it up, I was thinking of making my complaints something other than what you just listed.」

437:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, the stopped-being-the-quiet-type crowd just doesn't have much bite to their jokes.」

437:t_10:24.en:
$n
「Then I'll tell you what I really think.」

437:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I didn't mean for you to say that sort of thing...」

437:t_10:26.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. Thanks to you, I was able to fight again.」

437:t_10:28.en:
$n
「Come to think of it, we haven't really had a chance to talk like this since Miss $$スズネ$$ attacked us...」

437:t_10:29.en:
$n
「Since I have the chance, I'll say it properly. Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$...」

437:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, as a form of gratitude, let's do it! Let's give it our all again today...」

437:t_10:32.en:
$n
「That's the one thing I can't bring myself to say.」

437:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why not!? Everyone in $c except you, $n, has said it at least once!」

437:t_10:34.en:
$n
「Even $$宗介$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$刹那$$ and $$キリコ$$!?」

437:t_10:36.en:
$n
「Even Captain $$クルーゾー$$, Lieutenant $$カナリア$$, $$ビヒーダ$$, $$シャッコ$$, Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$, Major $$グラハム$$ and XO $$レイアム$$!?」

437:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... I managed to get them to say it, one way or another.」

437:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So that leaves only you, $n! Now then! Give your thanks a proper form!」

437:t_10:39.en:
$n
「No matter how many times you ask, that's one thing I absolutely refuse to do!!」

438:t_000:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What type of enemy is it?」

438:t_000:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Unconfirmed, but since they aren't transmitting an allied identification signal, we should judge them to be hostile.」

438:t_000:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So they're the ones who want to stop us from going to $$蒼の地球$$.」

438:t_000:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「If so, it's probably the $$サイデリアル$$.」

438:t_000:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Whoever the enemy is, I'm going to raise hell. That's the mood I'm in right now.」

438:t_000:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「(Just as $$相良$$ said, morale is high...)」

438:t_000:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「(Nobody has given up, have they...)」

438:t_000:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Huh...? It looks like $$クロウ$$ isn't here, though.」

438:t_000:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「If you mean that guy in debt, $$ＡＧ$$ stopped him and called him over.」

438:t_000:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「No way, that guy... Don't tell me he borrowed money from $$ＡＧ$$ too?」

438:t_000:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If so, he really has no scruples when it comes to money, that guy.」

438:t_000:11.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「(You're as hard on $$クロウ$$ as ever...)」

438:t_001:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Diving straight into close range out of nowhere... how reckless can they get!」

438:t_001:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Then let's hurry up and finish them off, shall we?」

438:t_001:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The enemy's numbers are not large. All units, destroy them in coordination.」

438:t_001:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Nice of you to show up. Today I'm using you guys to blow off some steam.」

438:t_001:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm with you, $$竜馬$$! Let's wreck everything in a big way today, if nothing else!」

438:t_001:6.en:
$$メール$$
「Jumping on the bandwagon of taking it out on them... that's way too cruel...」

438:t_001:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s! Sorry, but we're in a bad mood!」

kept_omissions: 438:t_001:6: Mel's 八つ当たりに便乗 has no stated subject; kept 'jumping on the bandwagon of taking it out on them' (impersonal), ひど過ぎ read as pity for the enemy Invaders, not a complaint about Rand.
437:t_10:6/t_10:7: the producer of the Z-Chips is $n in third person while AG appears to be speaking aloud (soliloquy); kept $n in third person as in the Japanese.
uncertain: 437:t_10:4: the pun is 'MI' (身, body/flesh) inserted into ジェニオン to give ジェミニオン; rendered 'Ge-MI-nion' with the husk (骸 = GAI) of Genion GAI; the token cannot be split, so the pun is written outside a token.

437:t_10:31/t_10:33/t_10:38/t_10:39: the recurring gag is everyone saying AG's catchphrase 'business, business!' (implied by 今日も張り切って... trailing off); the rows never state it, so the English keeps the trailing off and 'give your thanks a proper form' for 感謝の印を形に.
437:t_3:54/t_10:16: 'this guy' for こいつ (AG, gender not applicable) to avoid he/she.
437:t_3:71: 月のディアナ女王 = 'Queen $$ディアナ$$ of the Moon' (no token for the title in the sheet; matches earlier 'Dianna of the Moon').
437:t_10:16: 'Chip-miser' for 守チップ奴 (matches 2004_02 shipped); 'Dimension Joke' and 'sexual harassment robot' match earlier slices.
437:t_10:23: 脱ムッツリ組 = 'stopped-being-the-quiet-type crowd' (settled 脱ムッツリ = stop being the quiet type).
438:t_000:5: サガラさん = $$相良$$ (Sousuke), per the 2028_00 finished rows for Tessa.
437:t_3:64: 二段階 read as two transformation steps (Genion -> GAI -> Ray), rendered 'two-step form change'.
